title: How Google, Huawei, Microsoft, and Nvidia, as well as startups and university research teams, spent millions of dollars to develop AI weather forecasting tools (Tim Fernholz/Bloomberg)
summary: Tim Fernholz / Bloomberg: How Google, Huawei, Microsoft, and Nvidia, as well as startups and university research teams, spent millions of dollars to develop AI weather forecasting tools — Google, Microsoft and Nvidia are among the names vying to make forecasts more accurate for longer.
